title: Word-forming prefixes: 超, 多, 反, 无, 亚, 准
explanation: These work like English prefixes. 超 means super or beyond, 多 means multi, 反 means anti or counter, and 无 means without, as in 无糖 'sugar-free'. 亚 means second or sub, as in 亚军 'runner-up', and 准 means soon-to-be, as in 准妈妈 'mother-to-be'.
pattern: 超/多/反/无/亚/准 + Noun/Adjective

examples.zh: 她是一位准妈妈，下个月就要生孩子了。
examples.py: Tā shì yí wèi zhǔn māma, xià ge yuè jiù yào shēng háizi le.
examples.en: She's a mother-to-be, the baby is due next month.

examples.zh: 这种无糖饮料很受欢迎。
examples.py: Zhè zhǒng wú táng yǐnliào hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.en: This sugar-free drink is very popular.

title: Word-forming suffixes: 化, 式, 型, 性
explanation: 化 turns a word into a process, like -ize: 现代化 'modernize'. 式 means style, as in 中式 'Chinese style', 型 means type or model, as in 新型 'new type', and 性 means -ness or -ity, as in 重要性 'importance'.
pattern: Noun/Adjective + 化/式/型/性

examples.zh: 这个城市越来越现代化了。
examples.py: Zhège chéngshì yuè lái yuè xiàndàihuà le.
examples.en: This city is becoming more and more modern.

examples.zh: 大家都知道学习外语的重要性。
examples.py: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào xuéxí wàiyǔ de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.en: Everyone knows how important it is to learn a foreign language.

title: Other people, or me: 人家
explanation: 人家 usually means other people or a certain person already mentioned, and it's often used to compare: 你看人家. In a playful or sulky tone, the speaker can also use 人家 to mean 'I'.
pattern: 人家 + Verb Phrase, 你看人家……

examples.zh: 人家不想去，你就别叫他了。
examples.py: Rénjia bù xiǎng qù, nǐ jiù bié jiào tā le.
examples.en: He doesn't want to go, so stop asking him.

examples.zh: 你看人家，每天都那么努力。
examples.py: Nǐ kàn rénjia, měi tiān dōu nàme nǔlì.
examples.en: Look at him, working that hard every day.

point: 专用名量词：串、滴、枝、扇、卷1、卷2
title: Measure words: 串, 滴, 枝, 扇, 卷
explanation: 串 is for things on a string or bunch, like keys or grapes, and 滴 is for drops of liquid. 枝 is for stems of flowers or branches, 扇 is for doors and windows, and 卷 is for rolls of things like paper or film, and also for volumes of a book.
pattern: Number + 串/滴/枝/扇/卷 + Noun

examples.zh: 他手里拿着一串钥匙。
examples.py: Tā shǒu li ná zhe yí chuàn yàoshi.
examples.en: He's holding a bunch of keys.

examples.zh: 请把那扇窗户关上。
examples.py: Qǐng bǎ nà shàn chuānghu guān shang.
examples.en: Please close that window.

title: A round of effort: 一番
explanation: 番 counts actions that take time or effort, almost always as 一番. It goes after the verb, or before a noun like 努力 or 话 to mean 'a good deal of'.
pattern: Verb + 了 + 一番, 一番 + Noun

examples.zh: 他把房间打扫了一番。
examples.py: Tā bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo le yì fān.
examples.en: He gave the room a thorough clean.

examples.zh: 经过一番努力，他终于成功了。
examples.py: Jīngguò yì fān nǔlì, tā zhōngyú chénggōng le.
examples.en: After a lot of effort, he finally succeeded.

title: Degree: 特, 异常, 较为
explanation: 特 is a spoken way to say very or really: 特好吃. 异常 means unusually or extremely and sounds formal. 较为 means relatively and is mostly written, before two-syllable adjectives.
pattern: 特/异常/较为 + Adjective

examples.zh: 这家店的面特好吃。
examples.py: Zhè jiā diàn de miàn tè hǎochī.
examples.en: The noodles at this place are really good.

examples.zh: 今年夏天异常热。
examples.py: Jīnnián xiàtiān yìcháng rè.
examples.en: This summer is unusually hot.

title: Scope: 净, 一同, 大都
explanation: 净 means only or nothing but, often with a complaining tone: 净说别人. 一同 means together and is a bit formal. 大都 means mostly or for the most part.
pattern: 净/一同/大都 + Verb Phrase

examples.zh: 你别净说别人，也看看自己。
examples.py: Nǐ bié jìng shuō biérén, yě kànkan zìjǐ.
examples.en: Stop going on about others and take a look at yourself.

examples.zh: 参加活动的人大都是年轻人。
examples.py: Cānjiā huódòng de rén dàdōu shì niánqīngrén.
examples.en: The people at the event were mostly young.

point: 一时、不时、仍旧、依旧、一向
title: Time adverbs: 一时, 不时, 仍旧, 依旧, 一向
explanation: 一时 means for the moment, briefly: 一时想不起来 'can't recall right now'. 不时 means from time to time, 仍旧 and 依旧 mean still, as before, and 一向 means always, all along.
pattern: Subject + 一时/不时/仍旧/依旧/一向 + Verb Phrase

examples.zh: 他的名字我一时想不起来了。
examples.py: Tā de míngzi wǒ yìshí xiǎng bu qǐlái le.
examples.en: I can't remember his name right now.

examples.zh: 他一向很准时。
examples.py: Tā yíxiàng hěn zhǔnshí.
examples.en: He's always been punctual.

title: Again and again: 一再, 再三
explanation: 一再 and 再三 both mean again and again, and stress that something was repeated many times. 再三 can also follow a verb: 考虑再三.
pattern: Subject + 一再/再三 + Verb

examples.zh: 老师一再提醒我们别迟到。
examples.py: Lǎoshī yízài tíxǐng wǒmen bié chídào.
examples.en: The teacher reminded us again and again not to be late.

examples.zh: 我再三考虑，还是决定不去了。
examples.py: Wǒ zàisān kǎolǜ, háishi juédìng bú qù le.
examples.en: After thinking it over many times, I decided not to go.

point: 不禁、赶忙、特地、特意、偷偷
title: Manner: 不禁, 赶忙, 特意, 偷偷
explanation: 不禁 means can't help doing something, a reaction you can't hold back. 赶忙 means hurriedly, 特地 and 特意 mean specially, on purpose for someone, and 偷偷 means secretly.
pattern: Subject + 不禁/赶忙/特意/偷偷 + Verb

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她不禁哭了起来。
examples.py: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi, tā bùjīn kū le qǐlái.
examples.en: When she heard the news, she couldn't help crying.

examples.zh: 我特意为你做了这个菜。
examples.py: Wǒ tèyì wèi nǐ zuò le zhège cài.
examples.en: I made this dish especially for you.

title: Not necessarily: 未必
explanation: 未必 means not necessarily or may not be. It's softer than 不, and goes before the verb or adjective.
pattern: Subject + 未必 + Verb/Adjective

examples.zh: 贵的东西未必好。
examples.py: Guì de dōngxi wèibì hǎo.
examples.en: Expensive things aren't necessarily good.

examples.zh: 他说的话未必是真的。
examples.py: Tā shuō de huà wèibì shì zhēn de.
examples.en: What he says may not be true.

point: 恰好、倒是、干脆、明明、总算
title: Mood adverbs: 明明, 总算, 干脆, 恰好, 倒是
explanation: 明明 means clearly, obviously, and is often followed by a complaint. 总算 means finally, at last, with relief. 干脆 means might as well or just, 恰好 means it just so happens, and 倒是 adds an unexpected contrast.
pattern: Subject + 明明/总算/干脆/恰好/倒是 + Verb Phrase

examples.zh: 你明明知道，为什么不告诉我？
examples.py: Nǐ míngmíng zhīdào, wèishénme bú gàosu wǒ?
examples.en: You obviously knew, so why didn't you tell me?

examples.zh: 等了一个多小时，车总算来了。
examples.py: Děng le yí gè duō xiǎoshí, chē zǒngsuàn lái le.
examples.en: After waiting over an hour, the bus finally came.

title: At, in, on: 于
explanation: 于 is a formal preposition for time or place, like 在. It usually comes after the verb: 出生于 'born in', or before it in announcements: 将于下个月举行.
pattern: Verb + 于 + Time/Place, 将 + 于 + Time + Verb

examples.zh: 他出生于一九九五年。
examples.py: Tā chūshēng yú yī jiǔ jiǔ wǔ nián.
examples.en: He was born in 1995.

examples.zh: 这次会议将于下个月举行。
examples.py: Zhè cì huìyì jiāng yú xià ge yuè jǔxíng.
examples.en: The meeting will be held next month.

title: As for: 至于
explanation: 至于 means as for, and moves to a new, related topic. It often comes after one point is settled, to bring up the next.
pattern: Clause, 至于 + New Topic, Comment

examples.zh: 我只负责做饭，至于洗碗，那是你的事。
examples.py: Wǒ zhǐ fùzé zuò fàn, zhìyú xǐ wǎn, nà shì nǐ de shì.
examples.en: I'm only doing the cooking. As for the dishes, that's your job.

examples.zh: 这个计划我同意，至于什么时候开始，我们再商量。
examples.py: Zhège jìhuà wǒ tóngyì, zhìyú shénme shíhou kāishǐ, wǒmen zài shāngliang.
examples.en: I agree with the plan. As for when to start, we'll talk about it later.

title: Because of: 因
explanation: 因 means because of and is a short, formal version of 因为. It's followed by a noun and is common in news and notices.
pattern: Subject + 因 + Noun + Verb Phrase

examples.zh: 他因病没有来上班。
examples.py: Tā yīn bìng méiyǒu lái shàngbān.
examples.en: He didn't come to work because he was ill.

examples.zh: 比赛因大雨推迟了。
examples.py: Bǐsài yīn dà yǔ tuīchí le.
examples.en: The match was put off because of heavy rain.

title: Except: 除……以外
explanation: 除 means except or apart from, a short form of 除了. It's usually paired with 以外 or 外 after the noun.
pattern: 除 + Noun + (以)外, Clause

examples.zh: 除他以外，大家都来了。
examples.py: Chú tā yǐwài, dàjiā dōu lái le.
examples.en: Everyone came except him.

examples.zh: 这家店除周一外每天都开门。
examples.py: Zhè jiā diàn chú zhōuyī wài měi tiān dōu kāimén.
examples.en: This shop is open every day except Monday.

title: Unexpectedly: 不料
explanation: 不料 means unexpectedly or to my surprise, and starts the clause with the surprise. The first clause usually says what was planned or expected.
pattern: Plan/Expectation, 不料 + Surprise

examples.zh: 我本想早一点儿出门，不料下起了大雨。
examples.py: Wǒ běn xiǎng zǎo yìdiǎnr chūmén, búliào xià qǐ le dà yǔ.
examples.en: I meant to leave early, but then it started pouring.

examples.zh: 我去找他，不料他已经搬走了。
examples.py: Wǒ qù zhǎo tā, búliào tā yǐjīng bān zǒu le.
examples.en: I went to look for him, only to find he'd already moved out.

title: 所 + verb + 的
explanation: 所 goes before a verb in the pattern 所 + verb + 的 to mean 'what someone does'. It's formal and can usually be left out without changing the meaning.
pattern: (Subject) + 所 + Verb + 的 (+ Noun)

examples.zh: 这就是我所知道的。
examples.py: Zhè jiù shì wǒ suǒ zhīdào de.
examples.en: That's all I know.

examples.zh: 大家所说的那个人就是他。
examples.py: Dàjiā suǒ shuō de nàge rén jiù shì tā.
examples.en: He's the person everyone's been talking about.

title: Sentence-final 啦 and 嘛
explanation: 啦 is 了 and 啊 combined, adding a lively or excited tone. 嘛 marks something as obvious, or softens a suggestion: 问嘛 'just ask'.
pattern: Sentence + 啦/嘛

examples.zh: 我们到啦！
examples.py: Wǒmen dào la!
examples.en: We're here!

examples.zh: 有问题就问嘛，别不好意思。
examples.py: Yǒu wèntí jiù wèn ma, bié bù hǎoyìsi.
examples.en: If you have a question, just ask, don't be shy.

title: Either way, or just as well: 也好
explanation: A也好，B也好 means whether A or B, it doesn't matter. Used once, 也好 means 'that's fine too' or 'just as well'.
pattern: A + 也好, B + 也好, Result, Clause + 也好

examples.zh: 你来也好，不来也好，都告诉我一声。
examples.py: Nǐ lái yěhǎo, bù lái yěhǎo, dōu gàosu wǒ yì shēng.
examples.en: Whether you come or not, just let me know.

examples.zh: 下雨也好，可以在家休息一天。
examples.py: Xià yǔ yěhǎo, kěyǐ zài jiā xiūxi yì tiān.
examples.en: Rain is fine too, I can rest at home for a day.

title: This and that: A这A那
explanation: Verb + 这 + verb + 那 means doing something about all kinds of things, often too much. 怕这怕那 is being afraid of everything, and 问这问那 is asking about everything.
pattern: Verb + 这 + Verb + 那

examples.zh: 他总是怕这怕那，什么都不敢做。
examples.py: Tā zǒngshì pà zhè pà nà, shénme dōu bù gǎn zuò.
examples.en: He's always afraid of everything and doesn't dare do anything.

examples.zh: 孩子一见到我就问这问那。
examples.py: Háizi yí jiàn dào wǒ jiù wèn zhè wèn nà.
examples.en: As soon as the kid sees me, he asks about all sorts of things.

title: Over and over: 左A右B
explanation: 左 + verb + 右 + verb means doing something over and over, usually without success. 左等右等 is waiting and waiting, and 左看右看 is looking from every angle.
pattern: 左 + Verb + 右 + Verb

examples.zh: 我左等右等，他还是没有来。
examples.py: Wǒ zuǒ děng yòu děng, tā háishi méiyǒu lái.
examples.en: I waited and waited, but he still didn't come.

examples.zh: 她左看右看，还是不太喜欢。
examples.py: Tā zuǒ kàn yòu kàn, háishi bú tài xǐhuan.
examples.en: She looked at it from every angle, but still didn't really like it.

title: With great difficulty: 好不容易
explanation: 好不容易 and 好容易 both mean with great difficulty, even though one has 不 in it. They usually come with 才 before the verb.
pattern: Subject + 好(不)容易 + 才 + Verb

examples.zh: 我好不容易才找到这家店。
examples.py: Wǒ hǎobù róngyì cái zhǎo dào zhè jiā diàn.
examples.en: It took me ages to find this shop.

examples.zh: 他好容易才买到了票。
examples.py: Tā hǎo róngyì cái mǎi dào le piào.
examples.en: He had a hard time getting the tickets.

title: That's true: 那倒（也）是
explanation: 那倒是 or 那倒也是 agrees with what someone just said, often after you hadn't thought of it. It's a reply, so it usually stands alone or starts the answer.
pattern: A: Statement. B: 那倒(也)是 (+ Follow-up)

examples.zh: “明天再去吧，今天太晚了。”“那倒是。”
examples.py: “Míngtiān zài qù ba, jīntiān tài wǎn le.” “Nà dào shì.”
examples.en: "Let's go tomorrow, it's too late today." "That's true."

examples.zh: “现在去人可能太多。”“那倒也是，我们晚一点儿再去吧。”
examples.py: “Xiànzài qù rén kěnéng tài duō.” “Nà dào yě shì, wǒmen wǎn yìdiǎnr zài qù ba.”
examples.en: "There might be too many people if we go now." "Good point, let's go a bit later."

title: Forget it: 算了
explanation: 算了 means forget it or let it go. It can stand alone, or follow a clause with 就: 太贵了就算了 'if it's too expensive, forget it'.
pattern: 算了, Clause / Clause + 就算了

examples.zh: 算了，别跟他生气了。
examples.py: Suàn le, bié gēn tā shēngqì le.
examples.en: Forget it, don't be angry with him.

examples.zh: 太贵了就算了，我们去别的地方看看。
examples.py: Tài guì le jiù suàn le, wǒmen qù bié de dìfang kànkan.
examples.en: If it's too expensive, forget it, let's look somewhere else.

title: That's enough, or just do it: 得了
explanation: At the start, 得了 means 'enough, stop it'. At the end of a suggestion it means 'just do that and be done with it', like 就是了.
pattern: 得了, Clause / Suggestion + 得了

examples.zh: 得了得了，你不用说了，我都知道。
examples.py: Dé le dé le, nǐ búyòng shuō le, wǒ dōu zhīdào.
examples.en: All right, all right, no need to go on, I know.

examples.zh: 你自己去得了，我不去了。
examples.py: Nǐ zìjǐ qù dé le, wǒ bú qù le.
examples.en: Just go by yourself, I'm not going.

title: Taking turns: 你一句，我一句
explanation: A一 + measure word, B一 + measure word shows people taking turns doing the same thing. 你一句我一句 is everyone chipping in to talk, and 你一口我一口 is sharing food bite by bite.
pattern: A + 一 + Measure Word, B + 一 + Measure Word

examples.zh: 大家你一句我一句，说得很热闹。
examples.py: Dàjiā nǐ yí jù wǒ yí jù, shuō de hěn rènao.
examples.en: Everyone chipped in and the chat got really lively.

examples.zh: 两个孩子你一口我一口，很快就把蛋糕吃完了。
examples.py: Liǎng gè háizi nǐ yì kǒu wǒ yì kǒu, hěn kuài jiù bǎ dàngāo chī wán le.
examples.en: The two kids took turns taking bites and soon finished the cake.

title: Here and there: 东一A，西一A
explanation: 东一 + measure word, 西一 + measure word means scattered all over, with no order. 东一句西一句 describes talk that jumps around without a clear point.
pattern: 东 + 一 + Measure Word, 西 + 一 + Measure Word

examples.zh: 他的东西东一件西一件，放得到处都是。
examples.py: Tā de dōngxi dōng yí jiàn xī yí jiàn, fàng de dàochù dōu shì.
examples.en: His things are scattered everywhere.

examples.zh: 他说话东一句西一句的，我听不明白。
examples.py: Tā shuōhuà dōng yí jù xī yí jù de, wǒ tīng bu míngbai.
examples.en: He jumps from one thing to another when he talks, I can't follow him.

title: Up to, until: 到……为止
explanation: 到……为止 means up to or until a certain point, in time or in amount. 到现在为止 means 'so far' and 就到这里为止 means 'let's stop here'.
pattern: 到 + Time/Point + 为止

examples.zh: 到现在为止，已经有一百多人报名了。
examples.py: Dào xiànzài wéizhǐ, yǐjīng yǒu yìbǎi duō rén bàomíng le.
examples.en: So far, more than a hundred people have signed up.

examples.zh: 今天的课就到这里为止。
examples.py: Jīntiān de kè jiù dào zhèlǐ wéizhǐ.
examples.en: That's all for today's class.

title: Even to me: X到Y头上来了
explanation: Verb + 到 + person + 头上来了 complains that someone has gone too far and is now doing something to you. It often follows 就算了 about other people.
pattern: Verb + 到 + Person + 头上来了

examples.zh: 你骗别人就算了，现在骗到我头上来了！
examples.py: Nǐ piàn biérén jiù suàn le, xiànzài piàn dào wǒ tóu shang lái le!
examples.en: Lying to others is one thing, but now you're lying to me!

examples.zh: 他管别人就算了，现在管到我头上来了。
examples.py: Tā guǎn biérén jiù suàn le, xiànzài guǎn dào wǒ tóu shang lái le.
examples.en: Bossing others around is one thing, now he's trying to boss me.

title: You won't know until you try: 不X不……，一X……
explanation: 不X不知道，一X…… means you don't realize something until you actually do X. The second half gives the surprise you got.
pattern: 不 + Verb + 不知道, 一 + Verb + Surprise

examples.zh: 不看不知道，一看吓一跳。
examples.py: Bú kàn bù zhīdào, yí kàn xià yí tiào.
examples.en: You'd never guess until you look, and then you're shocked.

examples.zh: 不比不知道，一比才发现他的汉语比我好多了。
examples.py: Bù bǐ bù zhīdào, yì bǐ cái fāxiàn tā de Hànyǔ bǐ wǒ hǎo duō le.
examples.en: I didn't realize until we compared, his Chinese is much better than mine.

title: Why you little ...: 好你个X
explanation: 好你个 + noun is said when you catch someone out, with mock anger or real annoyance. It's spoken and usually used with people you know well.
pattern: 好你个 + Noun/Name, Clause

examples.zh: 好你个小子，原来是你干的！
examples.py: Hǎo nǐ ge xiǎozi, yuánlái shì nǐ gàn de!
examples.en: Why you little rascal, so it was you!

examples.zh: 好你个坏孩子，又偷吃蛋糕！
examples.py: Hǎo nǐ ge huài háizi, yòu tōu chī dàngāo!
examples.en: You naughty kid, sneaking cake again!

title: Of all times: 早不X，晚不X
explanation: 早不X，晚不X complains that something happened at the worst possible moment, or that someone waited too long. The next clause names that moment.
pattern: 早(也)不 + Verb, 晚(也)不 + Verb, Bad Moment

examples.zh: 早也不说，晚也不说，现在才告诉我。
examples.py: Zǎo yě bù shuō, wǎn yě bù shuō, xiànzài cái gàosu wǒ.
examples.en: You didn't say anything all this time, and now you tell me.

examples.zh: 这台电脑早不坏晚不坏，怎么考试的时候坏了？
examples.py: Zhè tái diànnǎo zǎo bú huài wǎn bú huài, zěnme kǎoshì de shíhou huài le?
examples.en: Of all times, why did this computer have to break during the exam?

title: Look how ... you are: 看把你X得
explanation: 看 or 瞧 + 把 + person + adjective + 得 comments on how strongly someone feels, like 'look how happy you are'. The sentence stops after 得 and the degree is left unsaid.
pattern: 看/瞧 + 把 + Person + Adjective + 得

examples.zh: 看把你高兴得，什么事这么开心？
examples.py: Kàn bǎ nǐ gāoxìng de, shénme shì zhème kāixīn?
examples.en: Look how happy you are, what's got you so excited?

examples.zh: 瞧把孩子累得，快让他休息一下。
examples.py: Qiáo bǎ háizi lèi de, kuài ràng tā xiūxi yíxià.
examples.en: Look how worn out the kid is, let him have a rest.

title: Passing up the obvious: 放着X不Y
explanation: 放着X不Y means leaving a good option X unused and doing something worse instead. It's a criticism or a puzzled question.
pattern: 放着 + Good Option + 不 + Verb, Other Choice

examples.zh: 放着好好的工作不做，你想干什么？
examples.py: Fàngzhe hǎohǎo de gōngzuò bú zuò, nǐ xiǎng gàn shénme?
examples.en: You're giving up a perfectly good job, what are you thinking?

examples.zh: 他放着电梯不坐，每天走楼梯。
examples.py: Tā fàngzhe diàntī bú zuò, měi tiān zǒu lóutī.
examples.en: He skips the lift and takes the stairs every day.

title: What's done is done: X了就X了
explanation: X了就X了 accepts something that has happened and says it's not a big deal. The second part, often a question with 有什么 or a statement with 没有, plays it down.
pattern: Verb + 了 + 就 + Verb + 了, (没)有 + ……

examples.zh: 输了就输了，有什么关系？
examples.py: Shū le jiù shū le, yǒu shénme guānxi?
examples.en: So we lost, what does it matter?

examples.zh: 错了就错了，没有人会怪你。
examples.py: Cuò le jiù cuò le, méiyǒu rén huì guài nǐ.
examples.en: If you made a mistake, so be it, nobody will blame you.

title: Not this, not that: 这也不X，那也不Y
explanation: 这也不X，那也不Y means someone rejects everything, so nothing pleases them. It usually shows impatience with a fussy person.
pattern: 这也不 + Verb, 那也不 + Verb

examples.zh: 你这也不吃，那也不吃，到底想吃什么？
examples.py: Nǐ zhè yě bù chī, nà yě bù chī, dàodǐ xiǎng chī shénme?
examples.en: You won't eat this or that, so what do you want to eat?

examples.zh: 他这也不喜欢，那也不想要，真难办。
examples.py: Tā zhè yě bù xǐhuan, nà yě bù xiǎng yào, zhēn nán bàn.
examples.en: He doesn't like this and doesn't want that, he's really hard to deal with.

title: X is X, but Y is Y: X归X，Y归Y
explanation: X归X，Y归Y keeps two things apart: X is fine, but it doesn't change Y. 朋友归朋友 means 'friends are friends, but...'.
pattern: X + 归 + X, Y + Comment

examples.zh: 朋友归朋友，钱的事要说清楚。
examples.py: Péngyou guī péngyou, qián de shì yào shuō qīngchu.
examples.en: Friends are friends, but money matters need to be clear.

examples.zh: 玩归玩，作业还是要写完的。
examples.py: Wán guī wán, zuòyè háishi yào xiě wán de.
examples.en: Having fun is fine, but you still have to finish your homework.

title: Look at you: 看你X的
explanation: 看你 + adjective + 的 comments on how someone looks or feels, often teasing or calming them down. 看你急的 means 'look how worked up you are'.
pattern: 看/瞧 + Person + Adjective + 的

examples.zh: 看你急的，慢慢说。
examples.py: Kàn nǐ jí de, mànman shuō.
examples.en: Look how worked up you are, take your time.

examples.zh: 瞧他高兴的，像个孩子似的。
examples.py: Qiáo tā gāoxìng de, xiàng ge háizi shìde.
examples.en: Look how happy he is, just like a kid.

title: Completely: Verb/Adjective + 透了
explanation: 透了 after a verb or adjective means completely, through and through. 湿透了 is soaked through, and 坏透了 is rotten to the core. It's often used for bad things.
pattern: Verb/Adjective + 透 + 了

examples.zh: 我的衣服全湿透了。
examples.py: Wǒ de yīfu quán shī tòu le.
examples.en: My clothes are soaked through.

examples.zh: 这个人坏透了。
examples.py: Zhège rén huài tòu le.
examples.en: This person is rotten to the core.

point: （1）主语（非生物体）+把+宾语+动词+其他成分
title: 把 with a non-living subject
explanation: The subject of a 把 sentence doesn't have to be a person. Things like wind, rain or news can be the subject that causes the change to the object.
pattern: Thing + 把 + Object + Verb + Result

examples.zh: 这场大雨把我的衣服都打湿了。
examples.py: Zhè cháng dà yǔ bǎ wǒ de yīfu dōu dǎ shī le.
examples.en: The downpour got my clothes all wet.

examples.zh: 风把门吹开了。
examples.py: Fēng bǎ mén chuī kāi le.
examples.en: The wind blew the door open.

point: （2）主语+把+宾语（施事）+动词+其他成分
title: 把 where the object is the one affected
explanation: Here the noun after 把 is the person who ends up in a state, like tired or scared, and the subject is the cause. 这几天把我累坏了 means 'these days have worn me out'.
pattern: Cause + 把 + Person + Verb/Adjective + Result

examples.zh: 这几天可把我累坏了。
examples.py: Zhè jǐ tiān kě bǎ wǒ lèi huài le.
examples.en: These past few days have really worn me out.

examples.zh: 那部电影把孩子吓哭了。
examples.py: Nà bù diànyǐng bǎ háizi xià kū le.
examples.en: That film scared the kid to tears.

title: One moment ... the next: 一时……一时……
explanation: 一时A一时B means one moment A, the next B, for things that keep switching. It often shows that someone or something is unsteady.
pattern: 一时 + A, 一时 + B

examples.zh: 他一时说要去，一时又说不去。
examples.py: Tā yìshí shuō yào qù, yìshí yòu shuō bú qù.
examples.en: One moment he says he's going, the next he says he isn't.

examples.zh: 这几天的天气一时冷一时热。
examples.py: Zhè jǐ tiān de tiānqì yìshí lěng yìshí rè.
examples.en: These days the weather is cold one minute and hot the next.

title: Either ... or: 要么……要么……
explanation: 要么A，要么B gives two choices and says one of them must happen. It's spoken and fairly firm.
pattern: 要么 + A, 要么 + B

examples.zh: 要么你去，要么我去，总得有一个人去。
examples.py: Yàome nǐ qù, yàome wǒ qù, zǒng děi yǒu yí gè rén qù.
examples.en: Either you go or I go, someone has to.

examples.zh: 周末我要么在家看书，要么出去爬山。
examples.py: Zhōumò wǒ yàome zài jiā kàn shū, yàome chūqu pá shān.
examples.en: On weekends I either read at home or go hiking.

title: Although: 虽……但……
explanation: 虽 is a short, formal 虽然, and it goes after the subject. The second clause uses 但, 可, 却 or 也 for the contrast.
pattern: Subject + 虽 + A, 但/可/却/也 + B

examples.zh: 他虽年轻，但经验很丰富。
examples.py: Tā suī niánqīng, dàn jīngyàn hěn fēngfù.
examples.en: He's young, but he has a lot of experience.

examples.zh: 这家店虽小，东西却很全。
examples.py: Zhè jiā diàn suī xiǎo, dōngxi què hěn quán.
examples.en: This shop is small, but it has everything.

title: Every single: 凡是……都……
explanation: 凡是 means every or all that fit a description, with no exceptions. 都 must come in the second clause.
pattern: 凡是 + Description, 都 + Verb Phrase

examples.zh: 凡是去过那里的人，都说那里很美。
examples.py: Fánshì qù guo nàlǐ de rén, dōu shuō nàlǐ hěn měi.
examples.en: Everyone who's been there says it's beautiful.

examples.zh: 凡是他喜欢的东西，他都想买。
examples.py: Fánshì tā xǐhuan de dōngxi, tā dōu xiǎng mǎi.
examples.en: He wants to buy everything he likes.

title: Only if: 除非……才……
explanation: 除非A，才B means B happens only if A happens. A is the one condition that must be met.
pattern: 除非 + Condition, (Subject) + 才 + Result

examples.zh: 除非你去请他，他才会来。
examples.py: Chúfēi nǐ qù qǐng tā, tā cái huì lái.
examples.en: He'll only come if you go and invite him.

examples.zh: 除非下大雨，比赛才会取消。
examples.py: Chúfēi xià dà yǔ, bǐsài cái huì qǔxiāo.
examples.en: The match will only be cancelled if it pours.

title: Unless: 除非……否则……
explanation: 除非A，否则B means unless A happens, B will be the result. Compare 除非……才, which says what happens if A is met.
pattern: 除非 + Condition, 否则/不然 + Result

examples.zh: 除非你跟我一起去，否则我不去。
examples.py: Chúfēi nǐ gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù, fǒuzé wǒ bú qù.
examples.en: I'm not going unless you come with me.

examples.zh: 除非有特别的原因，不然他不会迟到。
examples.py: Chúfēi yǒu tèbié de yuányīn, bùrán tā bú huì chídào.
examples.en: He won't be late unless there's a special reason.

title: Even if: 就算……也……
explanation: 就算 means even if, and is a spoken word like 即使. 也 goes in the second clause.
pattern: 就算 + Condition, Subject + 也 + Verb

examples.zh: 就算明天下雪，我也要去。
examples.py: Jiùsuàn míngtiān xià xuě, wǒ yě yào qù.
examples.en: Even if it snows tomorrow, I'm going.

examples.zh: 就算失败了，也没有关系。
examples.py: Jiùsuàn shībài le, yě méiyǒu guānxi.
examples.en: Even if it fails, that's okay.

title: So that: ……，以便……
explanation: 以便 means so that or in order to make it easier. It starts the second clause and sounds formal.
pattern: Action, 以便 + Purpose

examples.zh: 请留下你的电话，以便我们跟你联系。
examples.py: Qǐng liú xià nǐ de diànhuà, yǐbiàn wǒmen gēn nǐ liánxì.
examples.en: Please leave your phone number so we can contact you.

examples.zh: 他每天记下新学的词，以便以后复习。
examples.py: Tā měi tiān jì xià xīn xué de cí, yǐbiàn yǐhòu fùxí.
examples.en: Every day he writes down the new words he learned so he can review them later.
